rca of the issue: Architect fast-path bug RCA: (1) Reproduction: POST /api/freebuild-chat/project/{pid}/agent-chat-stream with message='أريد design system معماري لـ SaaS multi-tenant مع ERD diagram', user_language='ar'. Expected: stream events classifier → cortex_started → cortex_step → architecture_blueprint → done(model_used=architect_cortex/...). Actual: classifier event fires (primary=architect, conf=0.9), then stream falls through to legacy stream_agent_turn (events: start, provider, build_plan, text_delta, tool_building, tool, ...). (2) Root cause: freebuild_chat.py:8291-8297 invokes stream_architect_cortex with 10 kwargs (project, user_message, history, ctx_holder, user_language, auth_token, db, is_owner, max_iterations, inject_workflow_addendum) but architect_cortex.py:177 only declares (user_message, project=None, brand_dna=None). Python raises TypeError 'unexpected keyword argument history'. (3) Why silent: the surrounding `try ... except Exception as _ce2: logger.warning(...)` block at 8327-8328 swallows the error with only the message string — no stack trace — and execution continues past the `if _routed_via_cortex:` guard since `_routed_via_cortex` remained False. (4) Mitigation: change call site to `async for chunk in stream_architect_cortex(user_message=message, project=proj, brand_dna=proj.get('brand_dna')): ...` — matches the actual signature. Optionally change `except Exception as _ce2: logger.warning(...)` to `logger.exception(...)` to prevent future silent failures.
